- ac1: trend -0.0304 (decreasing autocorrelation)
- skewness: trend 0.039 (increasing)
- kurtosis: trend 0.0389 (increasing)
- trend_slope: trend -0.3563 (strongly decreasing)
- tau_variance: trend -0.0129 (slightly decreasing)
- tau_ac1: trend -0.0223 (decreasing)
- low_freq_power: trend 0.0288 (increasing)

These trends are mixed. Some early warning signals like increasing variance, autocorrelation, skewness, kurtosis, low frequency power would suggest approaching tipping point. But here ac1 is decreasing, variance_log_ratio is slightly decreasing, trend_slope is strongly decreasing. Low_freq_power is increasing slightly, skewness and kurtosis increasing slightly.
